Description (SPA): Clave numerica de entidad federativa, igual a id_estado en dim_geography.
Description (ENG): Numeric state key, matches id_estado in dim_geography.

Notes: Kept identical to dim_geography for easy joins.

Description (SPA): Indica si la entidad elige un/a gobernador/a.
Description (ENG): Whether the entity elects a governor.
Notes: Only CDMX is 0; its executive is Jefe/a de Gobierno, tracked here as functionally equivalent but flagged.

Description (SPA): Duracion legal del periodo de gobernador/a en años.
Description (ENG): Legal governor term length in years.
Notes: Baja California (5) and Quintana Roo (5) were shortened by law to synchronize with the 2027 cycle.

Description (SPA): Año de la ultima eleccion de gobernador/a celebrada.
Description (ENG): Year of the most recent gubernatorial election held.

Description (SPA): Año de la proxima eleccion de gobernador/a.
Description (ENG): Year of the next scheduled gubernatorial election.
Notes: States cluster in four waves: 2027 (17 states), 2028 (4), 2029 (2: Coahuila, Mexico), 2030 (9 + CDMX).

Description (SPA): Duracion del periodo de diputados locales.
Description (ENG): Local congress term length in years.

Description (SPA): Años de proxima(s) eleccion(es) de congreso local conocidas.
Description (ENG): Known upcoming local congress election year(s).
Notes: Local congress elects every 3 years so most states show two upcoming cycles when known.
Uniform 3-year term; CDMX uses alcaldias on the same cadence.

Description (SPA): Años de proxima(s) eleccion(es) municipal(es) conocidas.
Notes: Oaxaca has many municipios governed by usos y costumbres, outside party elections.

Description (SPA): Bandera que indica si la entidad elige gobernador/a en 2027.
Description (ENG): Flag indicating whether the entity elects a governor in 2027.
Notes: Convenience column for the 2027 intermediate/midterm cycle query.

Description (SPA): Notas relevantes sobre el calendario electoral estatal.
Description (ENG): Relevant notes about the state's electoral calendar.
Notes: Explains term-length exceptions, concurrency with federal elections, usos y costumbres, etc.
Synthesized from INE calendars, OPLE sites, and Wikipedia as of 2026-07; exact 2027/2028 dates not yet published by INE (expected Sept 2026).

Description (SPA): Marca de tiempo de insercion generada por SQLite.
